commonScopeSpecification.problem: Current callback returns a boolean per registry edge; recursion can accept edgeA<-B in scopeS1 and edgeB<-C in disjointS2 because no common candidate scope survives across the chain.

minimalApi.compatibility: Use this scope-carrying mode for native Mathematics. minimalApi.targetPolicy: For the smallest behavior-preserving fix, keep the existing per-bridge target-role condition from nativeTargetReviewedDemandWitness, in addition to carrying the common intersection. algorithm: For rootA initialize candidates=initialTargetScopeIds(A). No candidates means no native surrogate witness.
At each already accepted registry entry A requiredByB, apply existing canonical ordinary eligibility and path-local cycle checks.
Let edgeScopes=reviewedDemandScopeIds(A,B,candidates), and next=candidates intersect edgeScopes. If next is empty, this branch fails.
Recurse intoB using exactly next and a new path-local visited set. Never recreate candidates fromB memberships and never union candidates from different edges or sibling branches.

A terminal direct source anchor may stop this branch only with nonempty remaining candidates, in the same requested jurisdiction. This patch preserves existing source content/stage-review requirements rather than pretending the intersection proves them.

The root succeeds if one complete branch reaches a valid direct source anchor with a surviving scope. If exposing evidence, return the surviving scopeId(s) with one full path per scope and registry chain, rather than a boolean-only explanation.

Each sibling registry branch gets its own immutable candidate set. Any memoization key includes goalId plus canonicalized candidate-scope set (and applicable eligibility/evidence revision), not goalId alone.
nativeAdapterDetails: Enumerate each candidate scope separately; do not rely on nativeReviewedDemandWitness selecting the first scope and returning one unlabelled path.

For a scope to be returned, both endpoint role checks and every atom on the returned ordinary-only demand path must hold in that single scope. Use scopeId bound to the same native artifact; indices from different artifacts may not be compared.

Maintain current filtering for exact jurisdiction and offeredByNativePlanner or declaredByRepositoryGui. Preserve goal eligibility, accepted registry identity and independently valid direct original-source anchoring.
This is intersection along a branch and existential choice across complete branches. It neither promotes support goals nor expands target sets nor changes source denominators.
